messages:
Ana (Marketing): Quick ask — we need a conversion kit for next Wed's Inference Economics webinar: 1 hero benchmark slide, a 1‑pager PDF, 3 social tile sizes, and a lightweight Figma file for localization. Target CTA: signup link. Can design own copy but must follow brand guardrails. Deadline EOD Monday (48h).

Sam (Design): Got it. Can you share primary metric & a sample benchmark? Also what file sizes & export specs? For quick turnaround I'll do a hero + social first.

Tess (Legal): Quick check — any comparative claims vs competitors? If so send source citations. Also need trademark list for logos.

Mike (Product): I'll drop the benchmark CSVs: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token for three model configs. Also a short blurb for the one-pager.

Jen (Ops): Where should final exports land? Use the marketing S3 bucket or Figma team file? Also note we have an inbound routing update for webinar signups.

Leo (Marketing Lead): Heads up — we want a convert-focused headline and 2 alt CTAs for A/B. Keep brand tone confident, not hype. :sparkles:

Sam (Design): Ok copying that. Can you confirm hero dimension `1920x1080`, social: `1200x628` / `1080x1080` / `800x800`? Exports: PNG high, PDF print for 1-pager. Figma link will be shared.

Ana (Marketing): Yes those dims work. Data file: https://redwood-files/bench/webinar-inference-econ.csv (Mike uploaded). Tess — no direct competitor names; keep as 'industry baseline' language.

Tess (Legal): Understood. Will review final copy quickly; ping me before publishing.

Sam (Design): Timeline: I'll post drafts to #design-review by Mon 10:00am. If copies locked by tonight, I can hit EOD Monday deliverables. Tagging @Leo (Marketing Lead) for copy approvals.

Leo (Marketing Lead): Copy deadline tonight 8pm. I'll review asap. +1 on Figma for localization. :eyes: 

Ana (Marketing): Perfect — thanks team. Jen, can you update the inbound routing so webinar signups land in the `webinar-2026` bucket and trigger the nurture flow v3?

Jen (Ops): On it. I'll update the routing and confirm once the webhook is live.

Sam (Design): Quick note — will include a lightweight diagram of 'Serving vs Cost' — do we want a simple bar chart or a sparkline?

Mike (Product): Bar chart with 3 bars (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) plus annotation for cost/token. I'll provide labels.

Sam (Design): Great. Final ask: brand color palette & font? Using Redwood brand kit. Will pull latest from Figma tokens.

Ana (Marketing): Thanks — ping me on thread if blockers. :thumbsup:
